about: Chair sizes for the chair panel, served by GET /api/insights. Width = occupied width (the chair with its user, elbows and hands included), which is what has to pass a door. Length = unoccupied device length. Both come from measured users in the Anthropometry of Wheeled Mobility study, rounded to 0.1 in from mm. No bariatric preset: no manufacturer spec sheet could be verified.

source.title: Anthropometry of Wheeled Mobility Project: Final Report (IDeA Center for the U.S. Access Board, 2010), Fig. 3-3 and Fig. 3-2, manual chairs n=276: mean occupied width 685 mm, mean unoccupied length 1012 mm
Same report, Fig. 3-3 and Fig. 3-2, manual chairs: 95th percentile occupied width 786 mm, unoccupied length 1264 mm
Same report, Fig. 3-3 and Fig. 3-2, power chairs n=189: mean occupied width 707 mm, mean unoccupied length 1117 mm
Same report, Fig. 3-3 and Fig. 3-2, power chairs: 95th percentile occupied width 827 mm, unoccupied length 1340 mm
2010 ADA Standards for Accessible Design, 305.3: clear floor or ground space 30 in minimum by 48 in minimum
